nodes.label: id_cuen staging schema drift fix
nodes.rationale: C# entity maps IdCuen to id_cuen but NO migration ever created that column — it depended on an ad-hoc ALTER in prod. Migration 025 adds it idempotently; MUST NOT be reverted (latent bug; reverting re-breaks staging account edits).

nodes.rationale: Local useState only (NO Zustand); high relocation risk (coupled buildProveedorSnapshot + diff logic); caratula UI moves from Datos de Contacto into each account card; count badge replaces the single row thumbnail.

nodes.label: Orphan-detalle 409 bug
nodes.rationale: UpdateCaratulaAsync requires proveedor.Detalle != null and returns Conflict('El proveedor no tiene detalle') for the ~25/39 suppliers without detalle; moving caratula to accounts removes this failure mode (accounts always exist).
